term: existence and constituent preserving history correspondence
definition: Correspondence compares the chosen enduring history with history b: for every represented time and bearer label it preserves existence, and for every token it preserves constituent membership. Enduring false is the statue and true the lump; both have the Unit token initially, only the lump later. These are openly stipulated numerical persistence judgments. The map neither asserts ontological equivalence nor identifies enduring bearers with temporal parts.
